name: Porygon
reason: PriceCharting splits this card into two distinct products with different artwork/values within the same pokemon-aquapolis family: 'Porygon #103a' (ungraded $6.45, PSA10 $101.76) and 'Porygon #103b' (ungraded $4.94, PSA10 $227.64). Our source lists only a plain number 103 with no way to determine which variant it corresponds to. This is a known e-Card era (Aquapolis/Skyridge) print quirk where some commons received two different pieces of artwork under one collector number. Declined to guess since the two candidates have meaningfully different prices - a wrong pick would misrepresent the card's value.
